title: Croatian Dumplings with Earthy Ghee
description: A hearty and comforting dish featuring Croatian dumplings smothered in a rich, earthy ghee sauce.
instructions: Bring the vegetable broth to a simmer in a large pot.
Add the dumplings to the pot and cook for 10-12 minutes, or until they float to the surface.
While the dumplings are cooking, heat the earthy ghee in a small saucepan over medium heat.
Once the ghee is melted and fragrant, remove from heat and set aside.
Once the dumplings are done, remove them from the pot with a slotted spoon and place them in a serving dish.
Pour the heated ghee over the top of the dumplings and sprinkle with chopped parsley.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
